title: Agua de Rosas
bio: Agua de Rosas is a Chicago-based event, DJ crew, and label originally formed in Milwaukee in 2018. Agua de Rosas is the elixir del underground. They shape the Midwest’s Latin Club scene and link niche and emerging talent closer to home. Members are resident DJs and artists: J. Córdova, DJ Aguara'i, and karennoid.
